projects.title: Pomodoro Timer
projects.description: Productivity app with highly customizable cycles and automated E2E testing. Focused on burnout prevention.
projects.fullDescription:
## The Challenge
Create a time management tool more flexible than standard timers, allowing users to adapt the Pomodoro technique to their own biological and focus rhythms.

## The Solution
I built a SPA (Single Page Application) enabling granular customization of focus and break times. The app manages complex states to ensure users don't break the technique's consistency.

### Key Features
- **Advanced Customization:** Cycle configuration from 1 to 60 minutes and repetition limits.
- **Error Prevention:** Configuration lock during execution (defensive UX).
- **Auditory and Visual Feedback:** Circular progress indicators and subtle sound notifications.
- **Autoplay Mode:** For users seeking an uninterrupted workflow.

### Quality and Testing
To guarantee stability, I implemented E2E tests with **Cypress**, ensuring critical flows (start, pause, restart and cycle change) work perfectly on every deploy.

projects.title: Agencia de Borde
projects.description: 100% custom WordPress theme development with zero dependencies. Modular architecture with native Gutenberg and advanced filtering system.
projects.contribution: Redesign into a native Gutenberg theme with modular architecture and an advanced editing system.
projects.fullDescription:
## The Challenge
The agency needed a unique digital identity not limited by commercial template restrictions or heavy page builders (like Elementor). The goal was optimal performance (Core Web Vitals) while keeping flexible content management for the client.

## The Solution
I built a **Full Custom WordPress** architecture, translating the Figma design to code with pixel-perfect precision.

### Technical Architecture
- **Theme from Scratch:** Built from zero (no heavy frameworks) to guarantee speed and clean code.
- **Native Blocks (Gutenberg):** Instead of builder plugins, I developed custom native blocks, allowing the client to edit complex layouts without breaking the design.
- **Filtering Logic:** Implementation of a category-based project filtering system (Taxonomies) with async loading for fluid UX.
- **Internationalization (i18n):** Architecture ready for multi-language support (Spanish/English) without unnecessary structural duplication.

### Tech Stack
**Modern PHP** and **vanilla JavaScript** were prioritized to reduce technical debt and ease long-term maintenance.

projects.title: Claudia Ortega: Artist portfolio
projects.description: Website for a visual artist with custom masonry gallery and SEO strategy for brand positioning in a competitive niche.
projects.fullDescription:
## The Challenge
The artist urgently needed a digital platform to apply for grants. The main challenge wasn't just technical but strategic: **SEO positioning**. Sharing a name with a famous actress, her personal digital brand was nonexistent on Google. The design also had to balance an "ornate" aesthetic (textures and brushstrokes) without sacrificing usability or overshadowing the artwork.

## The Solution
I built a portfolio on **Native WordPress** with a custom content management system, linking visual artworks with related poems.

### Implementation Details
- **Advanced Masonry Gallery:** Information architecture divided into 5 techniques (Painting, New Media, Prints, Drawings and Watercolors) with optimized loading.
- **Intellectual Property Protection:** Automated watermarking system to protect image authorship.
- **UI Micro-interactions:** Details reflecting the artist's identity, like the "brushstroke" effect on the active menu and hovers using her artwork's specific color palette.
- **SEO Strategy:** Technical and content optimization that placed the site on Google's first page, differentiating the visual artist from her famous namesake.
- **Detail Experience:** Internal carousels to visualize textures and macro details of each painting.

projects.title: Sindicato Nacional Mutual de Seguridad CChC
projects.description: Union management platform with paperwork automation (registrations/benefits) and a simplified admin panel for non-digital-native users.
projects.fullDescription:
## The Challenge
The union needed to modernize communications and digitize bureaucratic processes (registrations, benefits), but faced a critical barrier: the team uploading content had no advanced technical knowledge. They needed a robust yet extremely intuitive tool where it was impossible to "break" the design by mistake.

## The Solution
I developed a **Custom WordPress Theme** focused on editor usability (Backend UX).

### Process Digitalization
- **Digital Paperwork System:** Implementation of complex flows for member registration and benefit requests (birth, marriage, etc.). The system manages mandatory legal document downloads and secure upload of signed files.
- **Information Architecture:** Organization of large data volumes (clauses, news, galleries, directory) through custom taxonomies and dynamic filters.

### Editor Experience
- **ACF + Classic Editor:** Instead of complex visual builders, I created a "rigid fields" interface with **Advanced Custom Fields**. Administrators simply "fill in blanks" (text, photo, file), ensuring the front-end design (based on **Bootstrap**) stays consistent.
- **Scalability:** The site remains active and client-updated since 2021, proving the effectiveness of the admin interface built.

projects.title: Bitluxe
projects.description: Cryptocurrency tracking dashboard with decoupled architecture. Reactive front-end in Vite and REST API backend in Django.
projects.contribution: Full-stack development with decoupled architecture, Vite front-end and Django backend.
projects.fullDescription:
## The Technical Challenge
Build a robust Full Stack application as the final exam for the Web Development Diploma (PUC Engineering). The requirement was to consume external data, process it in a custom backend and serve it to a modern interface.

## Solution Architecture
I implemented a **Headless/Decoupled** architecture separating business logic from the presentation layer.

### Backend (Django & Python)
- RESTful API acting as middleware, managing business logic and request security.
- Data modeling for users and favorites.

### Front-end (Vite)
- Optimized application built with Vite for instant load times.
- Real-time financial API consumption with async state handling.
- Interactive charts to visualize market volatility.

### Result
A scalable application demonstrating the full software development cycle, from database design to user interface.
projects.client: Final exam for Web Development Diploma (PUC Engineering)

projects.title: Tanta Plata: Financial management
projects.description: Research, ideation and prototyping of an agnostic Fintech app for unified expense and debt management.
projects.contribution: I led user research, journey mapping and Figma prototyping, defining the product strategy and freemium model.
projects.fullDescription:
## 1. The Problem and Context
Financial anxiety is a systemic problem in Chile. Our initial research revealed alarming data on indebtedness and lack of financial education, exacerbated by inflation and easy credit access.

![Indebtedness context in Chile](assets/images/projects/tantaplata/contexto-investigacion.webp)

## 2. Empathizing with the User
To center the design, we created archetypes based on in-depth interviews, representing users struggling with multiple debt management and end-of-month uncertainty.

![Tanta Plata user archetypes](assets/images/projects/tantaplata/personas.webp)

## 3. User Journey Mapping
We mapped the current user experience when projecting expenses, identifying pain points and key opportunities to automate data entry and reduce cognitive load.

![Alejandro Ibáñez's User Journey Map](assets/images/projects/tantaplata/user-journey.webp)

## 4. Strategy and Competition
We analyzed competitors (Tenpo, Mobills, Monefy) and defined a unique value proposition centered on intuitive visualization, approachable language and a viable freemium business model.

![Competitive analysis and business model](assets/images/projects/tantaplata/estrategia-negocio.webp)

## 5. Prototyping and Solution
The result was a low-fidelity Figma prototype focused on visual clarity and accessibility, designed to reduce anxiety through a friendly interface centralizing the user's financial health.

![Tanta Plata prototype](assets/images/projects/tantaplata/prototipo.webp)
